data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Ghazī', meaning 'raider' or 'warrior'. Ghuzayyah is a name of great strength and courage, evoking images of valor and victory in Islamic history. This name carries the spirit of the early Muslims who fought in the path of Allah, striving to expand the boundaries of the Islamic State. The name Ghuzayyah carries the meaning “Fierce, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghuzayyah usually hope their child will grow to embody fierce, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
